title: Preferred Painters of Gainesville Alternative for HOAs
description: HOA boards comparing Preferred Painters of Gainesville with Precision Paint Experts: the insurance, scope, and color-approval questions to settle in writing.
h1: Preferred Painters of Gainesville vs. Precision Paint Experts
heroIntro: When a community association hires a painter, the board answers to every owner. Here is a practical checklist for comparing contractors on an HOA repaint.

keywords.primary: preferred painters of gainesville vs precision paint experts
questions: What insurance should an HOA require from a painting contractor?
How should an HOA compare painting bids?

sections.h2: An HOA board's view of the comparison
body: Preferred Painters of Gainesville is one of the painting companies that Gainesville associations and property managers may be evaluating, and Precision Paint Experts is happy to be evaluated alongside. We do not comment on other firms. This page is for board members and managers who need to defend their choice to owners.
For a board, the lowest bid is only defensible if every bid describes the same scope and every bidder carries the right coverage. The paperwork matters as much as the painting.

sections.h2: Paperwork to request from every bidder
body: Our HOA guide to hiring licensed, insured painters goes deeper, but a board packet should at least include:
bullets: A certificate of insurance naming the association, before mobilization.
Confirmation of workers' comp on every crew member.
Whether crews are in-house or subcontracted.
An itemized scope: buildings, surfaces, prep, products, coat counts.
A written workmanship warranty and its length.

sections.h2: How Precision Paint Experts answers that packet
body: We are licensed, bonded, and fully insured in Florida, with workers' comp on every crew member, and we provide a certificate of insurance naming your entity before work starts. We use our own crews and do not subcontract.

The estimate lists surfaces included and excluded, prep steps, primer and topcoat by product line, number of coats, and schedule. Exterior projects carry a written workmanship warranty of up to 10 years, on top of the manufacturer's product warranty. Nothing is added later without written approval, which keeps change orders visible to the board.

For multi-building communities, the estimate can break the work into phases so the board can see which buildings are painted in which order. That helps managers plan owner notices, parking, and landscaping schedules. Prep steps such as washing, mildew treatment, re-caulking, and rot or fascia replacement are spelled out per scope, so the board knows what owners will see crews doing before the paint goes on.

Associations often have an approved palette or need owner sign-off before anything changes. We can match existing colors from a chip or a leftover can and produce full-size drawdowns for the board to review. If the community is updating its palette, our color consultation can help narrow options before a vote.
Exterior work is best scheduled October through May. Owners do not need to leave their homes, and the schedule is written into the estimate so managers can send notices in advance.

Common-area interiors such as clubhouses, mailroom areas, and stairwells can be scoped alongside the exteriors or on their own. Low-VOC options are useful when those spaces stay open to residents during the work.

sections.h2: Request a scope for your community
body: A crew lead will walk the property, measure, and photograph conditions, and the itemized quote usually arrives within one business day of the walkthrough. See our HOA and property management painting service, or request a free estimate for your board packet. We also handle commercial painting in Gainesville.

faqs.q: Will you name our association on your insurance certificate?
faqs.a: Yes. A certificate of insurance naming the client's entity is available before mobilization.

faqs.q: Can you present color drawdowns to the board?
faqs.a: Yes. We provide full-size drawdowns and can match existing community colors from a chip or leftover paint.

faqs.q: How are additional repairs handled once work starts?
faqs.a: Nothing is added to the scope without written approval, so any extra repair is documented before it is done.

faqs.q: What warranty comes with an HOA exterior repaint?
faqs.a: A written workmanship warranty of up to 10 years on exterior projects, plus the manufacturer's product warranty.
